Its smooth black or gray finish adds a modern touch, blending seamlessly with both residential décor and professional workspaces. Whether installed in a home theater, office, conference room, or data center, this wall plate provides a polished, professional appearance that enhances the overall quality of the installation.The standard size design ensures universal compatibility with all standard electrical wall boxes and mounting brackets, making installation simple and efficient. Its single port supports any snap‑in keystone jack, allowing maximum flexibility for future upgrades or reconfigurations. From network cabling to audio/video systems, this plate delivers the versatility needed for evolving connectivity demands.What sets this Standard Size Keystone Plate apart is its UL certification, guaranteeing compliance with strict safety and performance standards.
